scientific_integrity: Exact local coordinates, a proof for all closed points in the stated affine chart, and reproducible symbolic identities are supplied; neither an outside reviewer nor full global singularity classification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The local analytic classification concerns only the affine chart x0 != 0 and its single singular line; other singular lines and their intersection or boundary points are not classified. The proof gives normal/rational singularity germs on this line although the global threefold is nonnormal. Independent audit and exhaustive novelty certification have not been performed.
title: An equisingular transverse \(A_2\) line in the Han–Kwak multisecant threefold
